resolution_ladder_for_every_match: 1. HLTV fixture identity (both teams, event, start, best-of) - identity only, never fan votes
2. Polymarket / Kalshi two-sided prematch books joined on BOTH team names (or competition-scoped reviewed alias) + start time within tolerance
3. Esportsbook paired series prices (Thunderpick, Bovada, Pinnacle where publicly reachable), margin removed proportionally
4. Median consensus across independent money families
6. Own originated line: Valve VRS rating model, then HLTV world-ranking model, then bo3.gg series-results form model
7. Wide-book indicative midpoint, labelled guidance-only (never a validated pick)
8. Blank pick + published in Unresolved & limitations with the per-source blockers (no default 50/50, ever)
